violations.text: Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. At time of inspection, recently shredded crab meat was observed stored in stacked covered plastic containers greater than 4 inches deep at 44-50F. Per interview with PIC, crab was prepared less than 30 minutes prior, crab was transferred to smaller shallow metal containers and transferred to freezer to rapidly chill. Cooling methods reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/10/2026

The wall mounted quat sanitizer dispenser was observed not properly mixing the sanitizer chemical with water for a proper 150-400ppm sanitizer test with test strips. Per the PIC, staff are to manually add water and test the sanitizer mixture at 150-400ppm prior to each use until wall dispenser unit can be properly adjusted. New Violation. Correct By: 02/03/2026
